# Plugin.Maui.FileVault

Secure local files for .NET MAUI: AES-256-GCM encryption, platform-protected keys, expiration, purge, lock/unlock, and vault lifecycle management.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.FileVault
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.FileVault
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-file-vault
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Current release

1.0.8 (3 September 2026). Background lock always clears the in-memory master key. Prefer GetStatisticsAsync. RootDirectory must stay inside the host-chosen folder. Events.OnProtectionFailed reports platform protection failures.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.FileVault

Registration: `UseFileVault` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I encrypt files on disk in MAUI?
- Secure file vault with TTL and lock-on-background
- Store sensitive documents larger than SecureStorage limits

## Do not use when

- Small secrets — use Plugin.Maui.SecureStoragePlus
- You need cloud file sync rather than local encryption
